lesson.title: Wonder and the Lindy Effect
lesson.topic: Exploring how our sense of wonder can be cultivated over time, like ideas that persist in history.
lesson.steelman: How does the concept of the Lindy effect relate to fostering a lifelong curiosity about reality?
lesson.example: Discussing how Einstein's thought experiments continued to evolve and inspire throughout his life.

rationale: This lesson bridges the gap between philosophical wonder and practical antifragility by showing how curiosity can endure.
